claim.quote: We obtain a limit of b = 0.017(21) at 68.27 C.L., improving the previous best limit from neutron decay by a factor of four.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the journal version is Phys. Rev. Lett. 125, 112501 (2020) per the arXiv DOI.

name: Limit on the Fierz Interference Term b from a Measurement of the Beta Asymmetry in Neutron Decay

significance.quote: We obtain a limit of b = 0.017(21) at 68.27 C.L.

summary.plain: From the same PERKEO III data, the collaboration derived a limit on a hypothetical extra contribution to neutron decay, the Fierz term: b = 0.017 ± 0.021, a fourfold improvement on the previous best limit from neutron decay.
summary.technical: Simultaneous fit of A and b to the beta asymmetry of spin-polarized neutrons: b = 0.017(21) at 68.27% C.L.; statistically less sensitive than the spectral-shape determination but with much cleaner systematics.

title: Limit on the Fierz Interference Term b from a Measurement of the Beta Asymmetry in Neutron Decay
why_it_matters: The abstract says non-zero scalar or tensor interactions would imply an additional contribution to the neutron decay rate, the Fierz interference term.
